dataset: FBI Crime Data Explorer frontend agency roster snapshot
issuing_authority: Federal Bureau of Investigation, Crime Data Explorer project (GitHub organization fbi-cde; originally developed with 18F)
retrieval_method: git clone --depth 1 (GitHub reachable from session; FBI API host api.usa.gov was egress-blocked)
record_unit: UCR reporting entity keyed by ORI (Originating Agency Identifier); NOT a one-to-one agency census. State police and multi-county agencies appear once per county reporting unit.
known_omissions: Agencies that never had a UCR ORI; agencies created after mid-2018; renamed/merged agencies after 2018. Includes non-law-enforcement reporting entities (task forces, 'Other', federal).
identifier_availability: ORI (9 char), agency_type_name, primary_county, ICPSR lat/lng where available
licensing: U.S. federal government work (17 U.S.C. 105); repository license file governs code. Data reused as public-domain government data with attribution.
how_incorporated: Registry adapter 'fbi_cde_frontend' loads every record as a RegistryRecord with registry='FBI_CDE_FRONTEND_2018'. Canonical agencies are created one-per-record with research_status=REGISTRY_ONLY unless a curated seed explicitly links ORIs.
currency_warning: Snapshot dated 2018-06-28. Must never be presented as a current count. Superseding source: FBI CDE agencies API (api.usa.gov/crime/fbi/cde/agency/byStateAbbr/{ST}) with api.data.gov key, and BJS CSLLEA 2018 / LEAR when accessible.
